Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 11
Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely pivoted from Taylor Swift to Harry Styles after confirming that “Safe & Sound” was directed by Roman White, incorrectly assuming Swift was not the answer. They failed to check other Taylor Swift videos directed by Yoann Lemoine—specifically “Back to December,” which is indeed an orchestral country pop ballad directed by Lemoine—despite search results hinting at this. This overreliance on a single candidate song and ignoring available evidence led to the wrong conclusion.
